en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph shows a long Spanish Colonial style mission church with a stepped bell gable (campanario) at the front and a row of heavy buttress-like pilasters along the nave. Several bells hang in the arched openings at the top of the façade, which is topped with a cross. In front of the building are palm trees, a low white wall, and a dirt foreground, suggesting a warm, arid climate. The image has a white border and some faint, upside‑down handwritten text along the bottom edge.
